label: 💎 광물 박편 삼종 — 30·40·50대
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body group shot.
Three women in a row, evenly spaced with NO GAP between them, arranged left to right.
LEFT: mid thirties. CENTER: mid forties. RIGHT: early fifties.
All three dramatic hourglass figures, narrow waists flaring to full hips.
LEFT hair: dark copper, long and straight. CENTER hair: black, sleek low knot. RIGHT hair: silver-grey, cropped short.

POSE — THREE DIFFERENT STANCES, NOT mirror images, staggered heights:
LEFT stands in deep contrapposto facing the camera, outer hip pushed far to the side, one hand on that hip.
CENTER sits cross-legged on a low platform, torso upright and squared to the camera, hands resting on her knees.
RIGHT is mid-turn, one foot crossing behind the other, torso rotating so one shoulder leads, head turned to the lens.
CONTACT: LEFT's inner hand rests on CENTER's shoulder; RIGHT's inner hand rests on CENTER's opposite shoulder.

Body fully painted with: mineral cross-section texture, no unpainted ground anywhere.
LEFT — banded agate: concentric bands of translucent grey, white and pale blue following one another in tight parallel curves, each band edged with a fine crystalline line, the bands wrapping around the body's contours.
CENTER — malachite: tight concentric botryoidal rings in graded deep green to pale mint, each ring cluster nested against its neighbours, at the same small scale.
RIGHT — mica schist: overlapping platy flakes in silver-grey and pale green aligned in continuous wavy foliation streams, tiny garnet spots set into the flow, same scale.
All three share one cool mineral register so the group reads as a single specimen study. No transition or blending between figures is needed.

SURFACE — MANDATORY: bone-dry chalky matte finish, NO wet sheen, NO gloss, NO specular highlight. Shapes stay flat and graphic, never bulging off the skin.
Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible.
Motifs tightly repeated so each pattern reads as continuous texture at full-body scale.
No panel, no band, no skirt or bodice shape.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border no thicker than a fingerwidth; hands and feet bare. No second band anywhere.
ALL SIX hands fully visible, five separated fingers each, correct anatomy.
Nails long coffin-shaped — LEFT matte pale grey, CENTER matte deep green, RIGHT matte silver.

Footwear: all three wear matte charcoal platform stiletto sandals, 3cm platform, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a deep charcoal seamless studio void.
LIGHTING: a single hard key from the front left at 45 degrees, raking across ALL THREE bodies from the same side. Weak rim from behind right. NOT symmetrical multi-sided lighting.
Style: scientific fashion editorial. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 3:4 vertical.
